payload.name: recipe-fixed-ready-result
payload.description: Deterministic Tier-0 subworkflow that returns a fixed readiness result object without posting a user reply. It is an unapproved offline-design draft: it carries an unapproved draft PythonCode UUID 84313e5b-c871-4f9e-9623-3986db9c5b2a (content: result = {"status": "Ready"}), zero inputs, zero Tool calls and no dependencies. It returns a result object only; it does not post a user reply, change policy, write a file or perform any external effect. It requires Q1 validation and human Q2 approval before activation. The current Sempai sink cannot preserve this v3 Recipe draft (class 21 drops step_descriptions, variants and dependency_registry), so this is an offline-design export, not a submission or activation.
